implemented_contract.quote_time_et_semantics: Unchanged: source-provided quote or intraday bar timestamp when available; remains null for fast_info, eod_close_fallback, and unavailable rows.
implemented_contract.capture_time_et_semantics: New: local snapshot observation time shared across all quotes in one run and propagated to position reviews and index regime rows.
implemented_contract.online_path: quant/intraday_quotes.py get_intraday_quotes(..., capture_time_et=...) and quant/run_intraday.py pass generated_at_et-derived capture time.
implemented_contract.offline_path: quant/run_intraday.py _offline_quotes writes capture_time_et for eod_close_fallback and unavailable rows.
implemented_contract.review_path: quant/intraday_review.py propagates capture_time_et into positions[].quote and market_regime_intraday.indices[].

covered_cases: fast_info keeps quote_time_et null and writes capture_time_et
intraday_1m keeps source bar quote_time_et and writes capture_time_et
batch quote fetch shares one capture_time_et
position review and index regime propagate capture_time_et

production_impact.scope: Advisory intraday JSON/report inputs only; no new exit, entry, sizing, or allocation rule.
